note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions only: stages follow the story chapters, the named missions, the activity counts and the collectible counts the descriptions state.

stages.goal: Finish the opening and Chapters 1-2, learn the map, and start the world trophies that never need a mission.
stages.text: Play Gone Fishing and the first two chapters. Explore as you go: every new area and vehicle counts toward later trophies, and the Ocean Beach cocktail is a quick stop while you are in Vice City.
stages.title: Stage 1 — First steps in Leonida

stages.goal: Clear every named mission and stranger strand before the finale, and knock out the one-shot moment trophies while the story gives you the chance.
stages.text: Chapters 3-4 and the final mission, plus all five named stranger strands and the eight-strand silver. Mission-specific trophies are flagged MISSABLE: replay a mission from the pause menu the moment you miss one. Save before the final mission.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Story sweep and missables

stages.goal: Work through the activity list: ranges, races, fishing, arcade, bowling and the challenge menu.
stages.text: Try all 9 activity types, gold the 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 spots and 20 different races, beat Cal at fishing, and finish 50 challenges. The vague hidden trophies here trigger through normal play, so keep choosing and retrying.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Activities and skills

stages.goal: Sweep the map for every collectible set and world total: cards, WAiNK tags, meditation spots, vehicles and areas.
stages.text: Meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 card sets, tag 100 WAiNK locations, discover 100 vehicles, visit all 52 areas, rob one illegal operation per gang, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Collectibles and the world

stages.goal: Finish the big clean-ups, reach 100% completion, and watch the platinum pop.
stages.text: Rob the last bank vaults for the silver, then check the in-game stats screen for the final 100% requirements. When the last trophy lands, the platinum follows automatically.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Clean-up and platinum
